## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-juan Qing running-commentary in the *bǐ shuō* 筆說 ("brush-talk") informal-prose commentary format. X64 n1266. *commentedTextid*: [KR6q0099](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0099). One of the cluster of Qing-period commentaries on the *Chánlín bǎoxùn* ([KR6q0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0153), [KR6q0154](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0154), [KR6q0155](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0155), [KR6q0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0156), and this [KR6q0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0157)).

**Abstract**

Zhìxiáng 智祥 (1637–1709, DILA A001274), *zì* Tīngyún 聽雲, *hào* Pínjí 頻吉 (also Pínjí Zhìxiáng 頻吉智祥); Cáodòng-school dharma-heir of Yuánjié Jìngyíng 元潔淨瑩 (see [智祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E7%A5%A5) person note for full biography).

Dating bracket: notBefore 1644, notAfter 1720 (working Qing-period bracket). Catalog dynasty 清.
